Aphelion launches on PS5 in Spring 2026.

The Manairons are back… and this time, they’re not staying quiet!

Manairons is a 3D action platformer game set in the Pyrenees, where ancient legends mix with smoking factories, mischievous magic, and quirky little creatures. You are Nai, a manairó who has just awakened from centuries locked in the “canut”, a magical artifact as old as it is suspicious. A witch frees you (very timely, indeed) and gives you a mission: recover the “canut” and stop the chaos it’s causing.

The culprit? Llorenç, a landowner with zero charisma and a lot of machines. He’s used the power of the manairons to industrialize the peaceful village of Vilamont. Backrooms Level X arrives on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 on February 19, 2026!

Trapped in the infinite sprawl of the Backrooms' most terrifying level yet, you'll wander decaying yellow mazes that stretch forever, haunted by the hum of flickering fluorescent lights and the distant echoes of things that should not be. Every corner hides a glitch in reality, warped walls that shift when you're not looking, shadows that move on their own, and an oppressive static that crawls under your skin.

This isn't just survival horror; it's a descent into psychological terror where perception is your worst enemy. Solve cryptic environmental puzzles to uncover fragments of a shattered narrative, evade relentless entities that hunt by sound, and question if escape is even possible.

Order now on PlayStation Store and add to your wishlist. Dare to enter... if you can find the way out.
